from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial data from a single document regarding '其他应付款'."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document")
    other_payables_amount: float | None = Field(description="The '其他应付款' ending balance amount, in yuan")
    amount_currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024 年第一季度'")
    report_status: str | None = Field(description="Whether the report is audited or unaudited, e.g. '未经审计'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
